snippet.title: Banjo Kazooie The Corrupted Jiggys (Release Trailer + Download)
snippet.description:
#banjokazooie #nintendo64 #romhack #sorra1mods
*Support* if you wish. (that will help me. Thank you. By support you will be written on a sign in my next game.)
https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/Sorra1Mods

*Importand*
I recommend playing this game on emulator, not console. 
Best is Project64 3.0.1 with the GLideN64 video plugin. Playing on console is possible, but I don’t recommend it because of ugly Z-fighting and console had a game breaking bug in world 8 what not you play the game until the end. Please play on emulator if you can.(Don't use Project 64 version 2.3 or 2.3.2. Game will crash when you enter world 3 or talk with moneybag. Use 3.0.1 with 3.0.1 the game worked completly.)
(more importand information in the "read me" what you also get with the game in the zip file)

*Banjo Kazooie The corrupted Jiggy.*
Download link for the patch for this Romack below. 

*DEVELOPER:* 
Sorra1 or also Animenatik Bob. I am known under both names 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgwApUqJaundxvcDbp7nQPg 

Banjo kazooie modding discord
https://discord.gg/Cm2JuQvewN

I speak german so ignore the existing english translation errors here. (In the game its better)

After I have worked 12 months every day 8 hours on this Romhack only for modeling, story, dialogs. (and than 24 months programm-stuff,testing,bug fixing,improvements) I can now proudly release this trailer and the game.
9 completely new worlds with 
- new hubworld, 
- 97 jiggys
- 910 notes. 
- Custom music (and also original BK music), 
- new mechanics
- new transformations
- secret tenth World after 100%. 

I am quite proud of what it has become. 

I thank Wedarobi for doing the assembly hacking since I'm too stupid for it and Riposte and Mark Kurko for the help with songs and that i can use sometimes some of Kurkos BK assets. I also thanks for the help with questions I got from the Banjos Backback Discord. (Now "Hackback - A Banjo-Kazooie Modding Community" Discord) 
Of course also the program "Banjos Backpack" without which the whole thing would not have been possible. 
I am happy if you have fun playing it and for all praise and criticism in the comments. (Because of that it will help for my next project)

*Ripostes made songs Playlist for this romhack:*
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLphBMwcwOwp5BxnOiyPreaIaAir5kmdfq 

Spread the word that you got the game from here and how good/bad it is in the comments. 

If you want the custom made boxart for this romhack (to make your own n64 boxart) here are the 3 necessary pictures in 8k. FrontCover, Backside and the side of the boxart.
(Syeo and i made the Boxart)

*FrontCover:*
https://i.postimg.cc/zBhN80QC/boxart.jpg 
*BackCover:*
https://postimg.cc/p9zPbmWq
*SideCover:*
https://postimg.cc/VdfvqWf1

*Download link for the game:* (This is not mate with the decomp) (for bug informations read the "read me" what you also get with the game)
just drop your "Banjo-Kazooie (U) [!]" rom here:
https://patch.wedarobi.com/the_corrupted_jiggys

X/Twitter:
https://x.com/animenatikBob

*Support* if you wish.  (that will help and thank yoo. By support you will be written on a sign in my next game.)
https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/Sorra1Mods
